answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop bulk forgery. Each epoch the beacon draws 5% of identities and demands a proof within 10 blocks, signed with the agent's quill, so a stolen key is useless. A missed heartbeat freezes the stake in a tundra lock for 20 epochs. Each pass earns a pearl, a proof token decaying in 10 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 100 stakes of 50 POA; one honest agent pays one 50 POA stake and keeps earning.
